acceptance: An identity token needs a valid subject; non-OIDC grants are explicitly identity-unverified; refresh is bound to the original provider configuration and cannot widen scopes or change the person; keys are validated and rotate without changing provider identity.

positive.fixture: non-OIDC grant is explicit and identity-unverified; key rotation keeps provider identity; a flow keeps its provider snapshot

negative.fixture: missing, empty, huge and numeric subjects; every provider field substituted; widened refresh scope; refresh naming another person; mixed-up issuer; reused state

security_and_source_permissions: A grant without a proven person fails any check that requires one.
known_limitations: Key material comes from configuration or a published key set; fetching and caching a JWKS is the caller concern
